shortDescription: Manages certificate and/or key on the Central Manager.

options.name: common_name
options.description: Specifies the common name of the certificate. This option is required when creating a certificate.

options.name: duration_in_days
options.description: Specifies the duration of the certificate in days. This option is required when creating a certificate.

options.name: issuer
options.description: Specifies the issuer of the certificate. When no value is provided during create, the default value is C(Self).

options.name: key_curve_name
options.description: Specifies the key curve name of the certificate. This option is only available when the key type is set to C(ECDSA). When no value is provided during create and the key_type is set to C(ECDSA), the default value is C(prime256v1).

options.name: key_passphrase
options.description: Specifies the key passphrase of the certificate. This option is only available when the key security type is set to C(Password).

options.name: key_security_type
options.description: Specifies the key security type of the certificate. When no value is provided during create, the default value is C(Password).

options.name: key_size
options.description: Specifies the key size of the certificate. This option is only available when the key type is set to C(RSA). When no value is provided during create and the key_type is set to C(RSA), the default value is C(2048).

options.name: key_type
options.description: Specifies the key type of the certificate. When no value is provided during create, the default value is C(RSA).

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the certificate/key or the certificate, key pair.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the key and/or cert is created/renewed on the Central Manager. When C(absent), ensures the key and/or cert is removed from the the Central Manager.

options.name: subject_alternative_name
options.description: Specifies the subject alternative name of the certificate.

options.name: update_passphrase
options.description: Specifies whether to update the passphrase of the certificate. This option must be provided and set to C(true) when the user wants to update the key passphrase.
